title: PinnacleAI®: The Complete Story | Purpose, Research & Export Readiness
description: Explore PinnacleAI’s child-first purpose, seven-stage pathway, Class B software, research and Indian export documentation—with original sources and citations.
journey: A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, people, methods, everyday practice and review.
The seven-stage pathway connects capability identification and AbilityScore® measurement with readiness forecasting and a child-specific plan.
Integrated intervention, parent-guided practice, progress review and reassessment work toward growing independence and participation.
PinnacleAI® supports the pathway as licensed non-diagnostic developmental-support software with human and professional review.
stages: Forecast readiness and create a child-specific plan
Support parent-guided everyday practice and home generalisation
Track progress and correct the plan
Support growing independence, school readiness and mainstream participation

questions.question: What is PinnacleAI®?
questions.answer: PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 is identified in the supplied Indian manufacturing licence as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. Its stated functions include developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

questions.question: Who is the legal manufacturer?
questions.answer: Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the licence holder and legal manufacturer named in the reviewed regulatory records. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

questions.question: What does the Free Sale Certificate establish?
questions.answer: FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for the licensed device. It supports country-specific market-access applications; it is not approval or registration in another country.

questions.question: Does PinnacleAI® diagnose children?
questions.answer: No. The licensed product is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Clinical and care decisions remain within the appropriate human and professional review process.

questions.question: Has PinnacleAI® been registered in other countries?
questions.answer: This page does not claim a foreign registration. Each market will be labelled researching, representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review or registered only when the corresponding evidence is available.

questions.question: How can the evidence be reused?
questions.answer: Use the citation downloads and machine-readable JSON or text exports. Cite the exact licence, certificate or dated report for a specific claim and retain its date and scope.

questions.question: What does “operating system” mean in the PinnacleAI story?
questions.answer: Pinnacle uses GPT-OS in its product name and describes an approach spanning measurement, planning, everyday practice and review. The regulatory description is non-diagnostic developmental-support software; “operating system” is not a separate regulatory approval category.

questions.question: What does the export milestone mean for my child?
questions.answer: The Free Sale Certificate documents the device’s regulatory standing in India and supports international market-access work. For your child, the useful questions remain the individual goals, the care team, everyday practice, progress review and the relevant centre’s records.

questions.question: Where can a family start?
questions.answer: Call Pinnacle’s National Autism Helpline on 9100 181 181 for free guidance, available 24/7. The service is operated by Pinnacle Blooms Network / Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. Free guidance is separate from assessment or therapy charges; normal call charges may apply.

foundation.title: Class B classification
foundation.detail: The operative MD-5 identifies the device as Class B.
foundation.scope: The separate issued classification decision is still sought in this collection; the manufacturing licence is the inspected basis for the Class B description.

foundation.title: Form MD-5
foundation.scope: Names the manufacturer, product, version and non-diagnostic intended use. The FSC cites the base licence date as 20 April; each source is reproduced as printed.

foundation.title: ISO 13485:2016
foundation.scope: Read the certificate’s named entity, scope and dates. Management-system certification is distinct from a child’s clinical outcome.

foundation.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
foundation.scope: Describes the information-security management system within the certificate’s stated scope. Read the named entity, covered activities and validity dates together.

foundation.title: BIS IS 23485:2019
foundation.scope: The schedule names AbilityScore mapping, Prognose, Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI, and tracking and correction through Fusion within the certified scope.

foundation.title: Free Sale Certificate
foundation.scope: Records Indian domestic marketability and export of the licensed device subject to the importing country’s law.

research.title: The Indian licensing case study
research.description: Koti Reddy Saripalli’s documentary analysis of the April 2026 licensing case against later CDSCO guidance. It helps readers follow the regulatory reasoning; it is not an efficacy study.

research.title: AbilityScore® measurement research
research.description: Explains the measurement approach and preliminary within-network analysis. Read the methods, sample definitions and limitations with the reported findings.

research.title: The external-validation plan
research.description: Sets out a proposed validation study. A protocol describes planned work; completed external-validation results require their own report.
